name: Can I change my interior floor plan after the shell is constructed?
description: Yes, clear-span framing allows flexible wall placement, though underground plumbing lines embedded in the slab must be decided before concrete is poured.

mainEntity.name: Can I change my interior floor plan after the shell is constructed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can configure the interior layout after the shell is up, which is one of the primary advantages of clear-span structural framing. Because the exterior walls and roof trusses carry the building load, interior walls do not need to be load-bearing. However, plumbing rough-ins, drainage slopes, and electrical conduit conduits running beneath the concrete slab must be planned and placed before the foundation is poured.
